login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your account

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: Set a new password to continue.
changePassword.hint: At least 8 characters, letters and numbers.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You do not have sufficient permissions for this section. If you believe this is a mistake, contact your administrator.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.description: An unexpected error occurred. Try again or contact your administrator.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not exist or has been moved.

dashboard.intro: This is the school CRM dashboard. Modules are being added step by step.
dashboard.moduleComingSoon: This module will be launched in the next stages.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Student database — search and filters within your permissions.
students.filtersHint: Search by name, status or class.
students.name: Full name

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.subtitle: Teacher database — account, subjects and homeroom duties.
teachers.filtersHint: Search by name, email, phone, subject or status.
teachers.loginHint: Email or phone — at least one is required and is used as the login.
teachers.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, letters and numbers. The teacher will change it at first sign-in.
teachers.passwordEditHint: The password is not changed here — the teacher changes it themselves.
teachers.mustChangePassword: This teacher has not changed the initial password yet.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.subtitle: The schedule and grades rely on this list.
subjects.formHint: The Uzbek name is required; Russian and English names are optional.
subjects.deleteBlocked: Not deleted: this subject is used in lessons, grades or tests.

academicYears.title: Academic years
academicYears.subtitle: Academic year and quarters — grades and classes are tied to them.
academicYears.formHint: Filling in the quarters now makes the grades section ready to use.
academicYears.name: Name
academicYears.quartersHint: Quarters with both dates filled in are saved. Quarters are never deleted — only updated.
academicYears.isCurrentHint: This is the current academic year (only one can be current)
academicYears.deleteBlocked: Not deleted: classes or grades are linked to this academic year.

lessonPeriods.title: Bell schedule
lessonPeriods.subtitle: Lesson times (slots). The schedule is built on these slots.
lessonPeriods.formHint: Times must not overlap; the order number cannot repeat.
lessonPeriods.label: Note
lessonPeriods.deleteBlocked: Not deleted: lessons are assigned to this time.
lessonPeriods.empty: The bell schedule has not been filled in yet.

classes.title: Classes
classes.subtitle: Classes, homeroom teacher and student roster.
classes.formHint: Two classes with the same name cannot exist in the same academic year.
classes.deleteBlocked: Not deleted: the class has students or lessons.
classes.assignBlockedOther: Some students were not assigned: they already belong to another class, or the list is out of date. To take a student from another class, use the “Transfer from another class” section below.
classes.filtersHint: Search by name, grade or academic year.
classes.name: Name
classes.scheduleHint: You edit the schedule in the “Schedule” section.
classes.scheduleEmpty: No lessons have been added for this class.
classes.studentsEmpty: The class has no students yet.
classes.addStudentsHint: Hold Ctrl (or Cmd) to select several. The list shows active students without a class.
classes.noUnassigned: There are no active students without a class.
classes.moveStudentsHint: Warning: the student is removed from their previous class. Grades given in the previous class stay in that class journal, so the previous class ranking will change. Every transfer is written to the audit log together with the previous class.
classes.moveNothing: Nobody was transferred: the selected students are not in another class, or their status changed in the meantime.
classes.noOtherClassStudents: There are no active students in other classes.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Weekly schedule — by class or by teacher.
schedule.chooseHint: Select a class or teacher to narrow the schedule.
schedule.formHint: Conflicts are checked on the server: a teacher, class and room cannot be booked twice at the same time.
schedule.deleteBlocked: Not deleted: attendance records are linked to this lesson.
schedule.subject: Subject
schedule.noPeriodsHint: First add lesson times in the “Bell schedule” section.
schedule.noSubjects: First add a subject in the “Subjects” section.

import.studentsSubtitle: Download the template, fill it in and upload the file. Validation first, then confirmation.
import.teachersSubtitle: An account is created for each row. If the password is empty, the system generates a secure one.
import.uploadHint: Do not change the template column names. The first row is the header, the rest is data.
import.limits: Only .xlsx or .xls · max 5 MB · up to 1000 rows per file. Nothing is written to the database during validation.
import.modeTitle: What should we do with duplicates?
import.modeUpdate: Update — existing records are overwritten with the file data.
import.name: Full name
import.moreRows: {count} more rows — only the first 200 are shown in the table.
import.confirmHint: Rows with errors are not imported — fix them in the file and upload again.
import.noReadyRows: There are no rows valid for import.
import.credentialsTitle: Logins and passwords for new accounts
import.credentialsHint: These passwords are visible only now and will not be shown again. Download them and deliver them to teachers securely. A password change is required at first sign-in.
